implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can press a key (or mouse) to flap
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_events maps KEYDOWN (SPACE, UP, W) and MOUSEBUTTONDOWN to Game._flap_action, which calls Bird.flap().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Bird physics with gravity and upward impulse
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bird.update applies settings.GRAVITY, caps fall speed, and Bird.flap sets velocity to settings.FLAP_STRENGTH.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Randomly generated vertical gaps in pipe obstacles
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._spawn_pipe_if_needed computes a random gap_center within bounds and a gap_size from _current_gap_size(), then creates a Pipe.
Pipe.update moves self.x leftward by self.speed * dt; Game.update calls pipe.update(dt) each frame.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Score increments when the bird successfully passes a pipe
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update checks pipe.has_passed(self.bird.x), marks it scored, and increments self.score.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends on collision with a pipe or the ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Collision detection in Game.update sets state to STATE_GAME_OVER when pipe.collides(bird_rect) or bird hits ground.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Difficulty gradually increases by varying gap size and pipe speed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._difficulty_progress() based on score; _current_pipe_speed() and _current_gap_size() use this progress to adjust speed and gap.
Screens.draw_start and Screens.draw_game_over are called from Game.draw depending on state.

implemented_requirements.requirement: HUD showing current score and difficulty level
implemented_requirements.evidence: HUD.draw_score and HUD.draw_difficulty are invoked in Game.draw during STATE_PLAYING.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Persist best score between runs (optional polish)

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete, playable Flappy Bird clone. Core mechanics—flap input, gravity, pipe generation with random vertical gaps, scoring, collision‑based game over, and difficulty scaling via pipe speed and gap size—are all present and wired together. The game loop, rendering, HUD, and start/game‑over screens are functional, and the code appears ready to run with pygame installed.
